source: NLPNP — Skilled Worker Category Eligibility Criteria Policy

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Applicants with NOC TEER 4 or 5 job offers must submit a valid language test at CLB/NCLC 4 equivalent, valid throughout processing
requirements.section: Skilled Worker Category Eligibility Criteria — language

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: No language test is required for NOC TEER 0, 1, 2, 3 job offers; the category accepts job offers in TEER 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 occupations
requirements.section: Skilled Worker Category Eligibility Criteria — language

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Have the qualifications, training, skills, and/or accreditation required for the job. Applicants must demonstrate they meet the NOC code employment requirements
requirements.label: Have the qualifications, training, skills and/or accreditation required for the job and meet the NOC code employment requirements
requirements.section: Skilled Worker Category Eligibility Criteria — qualifications

requirements.subject: employer
requirements.label: Employer must be permanently based in NL, registered with Service NL, and operated under current management for at least 2 years (1 year in special cases)

requirements.subject: employer
requirements.label: In the St. John's area: at least 2 full-time local employees

requirements.subject: employer
requirements.label: Outside St. John's: at least 1 full-time local employee(s)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: An offer in a TEER 4 (in-demand) occupation must come with a language test at CLB/NCLC 4 in each of the four abilities

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: No language test is required up front for an offer in TEER 0, 1, 2, 3; the officer may still request one at their discretion regardless of the TEER level

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: This category sets no minimum work-experience requirement: the published criteria are a PGWP with at least 4 months validity left plus a job offer of at least 12 months at 30+ hours a week, applicant aged 21-59; graduates of public institutions outside NL must first work in NL for one year

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Graduates from recognized public institutions outside NL must have a job or offer directly related to their field and work in NL for at least one year before applying to the NLPNP.
requirements.label: Graduates of recognized public institutions outside NL must work in NL for at least one year (12 months) before applying
requirements.section: NLPNP International Graduate Category — Out-of-province graduates

requirements.stream: NLPNP Express Entry Skilled Worker Category
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Be accepted into IRCC’s Express Entry pool of qualified candidates
requirements.label: Must be accepted into the federal Express Entry pool
requirements.section: Express Entry – Skilled Worker Category Eligibility Criteria

requirements.stream: NLPNP Express Entry Skilled Worker Category
requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Score a minimum of 67 points on the NLPNP Point Assessment Grid
requirements.label: Score at least 67 points on the NLPNP Point Assessment Grid
requirements.section: Express Entry – Skilled Worker Category Eligibility Criteria

requirements.label: Have the qualifications, training, skills and/or accreditation required for the job and meet the NOC code employment requirements
